notes: LOI TIM RA VA SUA TRONG PHASE (BL-016, nghiem trong): script theo thiet ke cua plan nap lai theo THU MUC. Do duoc tren may nguoi dung: index co 8 nguon / 39 diem, nhung data/uploads/ con 2 PDF KHONG nam trong index (KB_SAP_PnL_VinMotion.pdf ~603 chunk, Checkpoint VPN guideline). Da xac nhan bang thuc nghiem: seed rehearsal bang ingest_directory cho ra 655 diem / 10 nguon dung nhu du doan. DA SUA theo lua chon cua nguoi dung: chi nap lai dung danh sach nguon trong snapshot, co test giu (test_migration_reingests_only_snapshot_sources). Ket qua that: 39 -> 39, 8 -> 8.

LOI THU HAI tu sua: dry-run ban dau GHI snapshot ra dia, ma dieu kien resume cua toi lai coi 'co snapshot mo' la bang chung mot lan chay bi dut. Hau qua: chay dry-run hom nay -> tuan sau migrate that se 'resume' theo baseline CU DA LOI THOI. Da sua: dry-run khong ghi gi ca; resume chi kich hoat khi CO MARKER hoac (collection da hybrid VA con snapshot mo). Kiem: chay dry-run hai lan lien tiep -> khong resume, khong de lai file nao.
